questions.stem: Why can electron microscopes reveal more detail about cell structures than light microscopes?

options.text: Electron microscopes use brighter light sources
Electron microscopes have a much higher resolution because electrons have a shorter wavelength than light
Electron microscopes can view living cells while light microscopes cannot
Electron microscopes produce coloured images while light microscopes produce black and white images

questions.explanation: Electron microscopes use beams of electrons, which have a much shorter wavelength than visible light. This gives them a much higher resolution (about 0.2 nm compared to 200 nm for light microscopes), allowing far greater detail to be seen.
